checkinHint: Select today on the calendar to check in.

admin.title: System time and daily check-in
admin.description: Set the system time zone and configure daily credit rewards.
admin.zoneHint: Use an IANA time zone such as Asia/Shanghai. The system time zone controls check-in, daily usage and credit refresh times.
admin.zoneError: Enter a valid time zone such as Asia/Shanghai.
admin.poolHint: Timed rewards expire at the end of the system day. Permanent rewards do not expire.
admin.rewardError: Enter a valid reward amount from 0.01 to 1,000,000 with up to two decimal places. The maximum must be at least the minimum.
